zh-Hant.name: 彩虹泡泡砲
zh-Hant.summary: 用彩虹砲對準同顏色的泡泡，咻！一次消掉好多好多；3～5 歲也能玩。
zh-Hant.controls: 點哪裡泡泡就飛向哪裡；右下角小泡泡可以換泡泡

zh-Hans.name: 彩虹泡泡砲
zh-Hans.summary: 用彩虹砲对准同颜色的泡泡，咻！一次消掉好多好多；3～5 岁也能玩。
zh-Hans.controls: 点哪里泡泡就飞向哪里；右下角小泡泡可以换泡泡

en.name: Rainbow Bubble Blaster
en.summary: Aim the rainbow cannon at same-colored bubbles and pop lots at once! Fun for ages 3 to 5, too.
en.controls: Bubbles fly wherever you tap; swap bubbles with the small bubble at the bottom right
